main.summary: Mutable builder used to assemble `DataItemSecurityContext` values.
main.remarks: The builder supports object-centric configuration, optional identity-directory integration, known peer registration, recipient selection, distinct signing identity selection, and assertion validity metadata.

field.name: knownobjects
field.summary: Known objects attached directly to the builder.

field.name: recipients
field.summary: Configured recipients for the current build operation.

field.name: localobject
field.summary: Local object identity and certificate used to root the builder.

field.name: signingobject
field.summary: Optional distinct assertion-signing identity. When omitted, the local object signs assertions.

field.name: directory
field.summary: Optional identity directory used to locate additional known objects.

field.name: notbefore
field.summary: Optional earliest validity instant for generated assertions.

field.name: expiresat
field.summary: Optional expiration instant for generated assertions.

field.name: includeselfrecipient
field.summary: Controls whether the local object is included as a protection recipient.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a builder rooted in a local object identity and certificate.
constructor.returns: A new builder rooted in the supplied local object.

method.name: IncludeSelfRecipient
method.summary: Set whether the local object should be included as a protection recipient.
method.param: True to include the local object as a recipient.

method.name: WithSigningCertificate
method.summary: Set a distinct assertion-signing certificate and optional signing object identifier.
method.param: Optional signing object identifier. When omitted, the local object identifier is reused.

method.name: WithSigningObjectGuid
method.summary: Set a distinct assertion-signing identity using an explicit object identifier and certificate.

method.name: WithSigningObjectObject
method.summary: Set a distinct assertion-signing identity using an existing `DataSecurityObject` value.

method.name: WithKnownObject
method.summary: Add or replace a known object using an object identifier and certificate.

method.name: WithKnownObjectObject
method.summary: Add or replace a known object using an existing `DataSecurityObject` value.

method.name: WithRecipientObjectId
method.summary: Add a recipient identified by object identifier.

method.name: WithRecipientCertificate
method.summary: Add a recipient identified by certificate and optional object identifier.

method.name: WithRecipients
method.summary: Add multiple recipient values to the builder.

method.name: WithDirectory
method.summary: Attach an optional identity directory used to locate additional known objects.

method.name: WithValidity
method.summary: Set optional validity bounds for generated assertions.
